sections.title: Renewals in the next 90 days or overdue
sections.sql: select name as account,owner,renews_on,days_to_renewal,arr_cents as annual_value_cents,currency,health from success.renewal_queue order by renews_on,name

sections.title: Account health and reasons
sections.sql: select name,owner,health,reasons from success.account_health order by name

sections.title: Open actions
sections.sql: select account,name,owner,due_on,overdue from success.action_queue where status='open' order by due_on

sections.title: Evidence to review
sections.sql: select name,finding from success.privacy_review where finding is not null order by name
sections.note: Evidence reminders only. A blank list does not establish legal compliance.
